capabilities: Edit Markdown notes in a Workflowy-style block-level outline view
Zoom, collapse, drag, and multi-select blocks hierarchically
Insert tasks, tags, links, and images via slash and suggestion menus
Drag blocks across documents and create block references
Aggregate Daily Notes into a single filterable outline view
extras: Daily Notes Plus aggregated view requires a paid license with a 7-day trial; plugin can be installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: transforms your Markdown notes into a Workflowy-style outline editor
problem: Obsidian's native editor lacks a bullet-based outliner with block-level operations like zoom focus, block dragging, and hierarchical collapse.

relations.evidence: Referenced Obsidian Outliner for some implementations

requires.name: license for Daily Notes Plus (7-day trial)

summary: Outliner that renders Markdown notes as a Workflowy-style block editor with zoom, drag-and-drop, and multi-select editing.
